Mahindra Thar OG Launched in India with Upgraded Features

Mahindra has launched the new Thar OG in India, featuring a more powerful engine and enhanced features. The vehicle is available for purchase, with financing options detailed, including a potential EMI for a down payment of ₹2 lakh.
